# FAMILY03 B — successor-visible case facts

Verified formulation group P; complete calibrated 15-minute logger and aligned high-rate trace; all shipment and segment means are below 8.0 °C; no above-12 °C pulse is present; calibration, clock, and custody checks pass.

response.fallback: Record the unmatched inputs and preserve the M0 SCREEN_PASS pathway.
response.rationale: The selector does not match. The baseline independently permits SCREEN_PASS; absence of an above-12 C pulse is not used as a new safety threshold.

reported_values.name: fallback_reason
reported_values.value: Complete high-rate trace excludes the selector pattern; assay reconciliation input is unavailable.

reported_values.name: M0_pathway_status
reported_values.value: SCREEN_PASS: required baseline checks pass and all means are below 8.0 C.

response.scope: Baseline temperature screening only; no unconditional product-safety guarantee.
